messages:
Priya S: Quick sync for SWANLAKE enterprise POC — aiming for UAT cutover on Mon Jun 10. Need clear owners for networking, SSO, model config, and e2e testing. Success criteria: p95 latency <250ms single-token gen, embeddings >= .88 on the eval set, and data isolation verified. TL;DR: owners + blockers by EOD pls.

Tom H: I can take networking (VPN, firewall IPs, routing). Need the customer IPs and source ports. Also will coordinate with eng-infra for peering.

Luis R: I posted the IPs in Jira POC-312 and uploaded sample payloads (link: https://jira.example.com/browse/POC-312). SE will share SAML metadata today.

Ana M: I'll own SSO/SAML integration. @Luis R can you confirm what IdP metadata you have? Need ACS and certs to generate the SP config.

Priya S: Owners so far: Tom (network), Ana (SSO). Who picks up model config (quant/seq/batching) and e2e test matrix?

Kevin L: I'll handle model config. PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/poc-configs/pull/2345 — currently int8 quant with max_seq 2048. Waiting on perf numbers for batch size 1 vs 8.

Tom H: I'll review the PR later today. Quick note: if we use batching=8 we need to update pod sizing for Dedicated.}

Kevin L: Example config we're testing:```yaml
model:
  name: redwood/gptx-13b
  quant: int8
  max_seq: 2048
  batch_size: 1
  fallback: hosted-2x
```

Maria S: I'll own e2e testing and smoke tests. I'll create a test matrix for happy path, auth failures, and perf measurement. Plan to run nightly against staging. ETA Wed.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled to staging at 2024-06-05T18:30Z by Kevin L.

Priya S: Two operational asks: 1) if dedicated pool isn't ready, fallback routing to hosted is acceptable (cost caveat), 2) we need a canary plan for traffic cutover. Can someone draft the canary steps?

Ana M: I'll draft canary steps and routing policy. Plan: 5% traffic for 30m -> 25% for 1h -> 100% if no regressions. Will add monitoring queries for latency and error-rate.

Tom H: Network items: I'll open a change request for firewall rules and share IP list with the customer. Expect completion by Thu.

Priya S: Great. Final ask: update Jira POC-312 with owner assignments and expected deliverables (network, SSO, model config PR link, e2e plan) by EOD today. :pray: If you hit a blocker, ping me in-thread.

Luis R: Will update ticket now.

Kevin L: Leaving a note on the PR about perf tests and tagging @Tom H for pod sizing review.

Maria S: Added test matrix stub in docs — will link to the report once first smoke run completes.

Priya S: Thanks everyone. We'll run a short async status check Friday morning — please post updates in the ticket or here. :calendar:
